verdict.rationale: Folk has a documented REST API covering core CRM objects: people CRUD, groups, custom objects including Deals, custom fields, enrichment, batch operations and webhooks. That covers a meaningful share of the UI. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and UI features such as email campaigns and sequences, dashboards, workspace roles and Gmail/LinkedIn sync have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage of email campaigns/sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, integrations/sync and AI-generated fields, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: folk exposes a REST API that is organized around predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts and returns JSON-encoded payloads
Create a person: Create a new person in the workspace. ... Update a person ... Delete a person
Deals are read and written with the custom object endpoints, with `Deals` as the `objectType` path parameter.
Request an enrichment of up to 500 people with Enrich people.
